On GraphRAG-Bench (Medical), RAGU retrieves the most complete context at every factoid level (evidence recall up to 0.84 vs. $\leq$0.76) and overtakes HippoRAG2 on synthesis tasks; on multi-hop factoid QA, the apparent HippoRAG2 advantage is shown to be largely an answer-format artifact. RAGU is installable via $\texttt{pip install graph_ragu}$, runs on a single GPU, and is released under MIT. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/RaguTeam/RAGU, and the Meno-Lite-0.1 model can be obtained from https://huggingface.co/bond005/meno-lite-0.1.
papers.title_zh: RAGU：具有紧凑域适应 LLM 的多步骤 GraphRAG 引擎
papers.abstract_zh: 图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过结构化知识增强大型语言模型，但现有系统在单次提取过程中构建知识图，产生噪声实体和脆弱的检索。 RAGU 是一个开源模块化 GraphRAG 引擎，通过将提取与合并分离来解决这个问题：实体和关系通过两阶段类型化提取、DBSCAN 支持的重复数据删除、LLM 汇总和 Leiden 社区检测。一个关键的洞察力激发了紧凑的提取器：管道中的法学硕士所需的技能——理解、提取、上下文推理——是语言技能，与事实世界知识不同，这些技能仅随着模型大小而增长较弱。因此，我们训练了 Meno-Lite-0.1，这是一个针对语言技能进行优化的 7B 模型，它在知识图构建方面优于 Qwen2.5-32B（+12.5% 相对调和平均值），并在英语 GraphRAG 任务上与之匹配。在 GraphRAG-Bench（医学）上，RAGU 在每个事实陈述级别检索了最完整的上下文（证据召回率高达 0.84 vs. $\leq$0.76），并在综合任务上超越了 HippoRAG2；在多跳事实 QA 中，HippoRAG2 明显的优势主要是答案格式的产物。 RAGU 可通过 $\texttt{pip install graph_ragu}$ 安装，在单个 GPU 上运行，并在 MIT 下发布。源代码可在 https://github.com/RaguTeam/RAGU 公开获取，Meno-Lite-0.1 模型可从 https://huggingface.co/bond005/meno-lite-0.1 获取。

papers.title: Agentic Skill Optimization over Lie Algebroids
papers.abstract: Agentic systems increasingly improve themselves by editing skills: prompts, rubrics, plans, tool contracts, examples, validators, and traces. Skill edits are not independent coordinates in a vector space: they are local repairs to structured artifacts whose effects are observed only after rollout, validation, and critique. Distinct edits can have the same immediate visible effect while differing in routing context, template state, guardrail scope, or future composability. The order of edits can matter as well: repairing a schema before a normalization rule need not be equivalent to applying the same edits in the reverse order. This paper introduces a new framework for skill optimization called LASKO, for Lie Algebroid SKill Optimization. LASKO models typed, anchored Markdown skills as the base category and available edit policies as sections of a controlled Lie algebroid with anchor $ρ$. The anchor maps an edit policy to its visible Markdown effect; the kernel $\ker(ρ)$ represents latent template, routing, or implementation structure; and the algebroid bracket measures noncommuting edit composition. As shown in the paper, LASKO achieves order-of-magnitude speedups in skill optimization in our preliminary benchmark results, primarily because it substitutes inexpensive Lie-bracket screening tests that run in microseconds, before investing in expensive validations that require running large language models. On a causal extraction from natural language task, LASKO achieved a speedup of almost $15 \times$ compared to a brute-force approach that validated all edits by running them through a DeepSeek V3.1 4-bit model with 671B parameters.
papers.title_zh: 李代数体上的代理技能优化
papers.abstract_zh: 代理系统通过编辑技能不断提高自身：提示、标题、计划、工具契约、示例、验证器和跟踪。技能编辑不是向量空间中的独立坐标：它们是对结构化工件的局部修复，其效果只有在推出、验证和批评后才能观察到。不同的编辑可以具有相同的直接可见效果，但在路由上下文、模板状态、护栏范围或未来可组合性方面有所不同。编辑的顺序也很重要：在规范化规则之前修复模式不必等同于以相反的顺序应用相同的编辑。本文介绍了一种名为 LASKO 的新技能优化框架，用于李代数技能优化。 LASKO 模型将类型、锚定的 Markdown 技能作为基本类别，并将可用的编辑策略作为锚定 $ρ$ 的受控李代数体的部分。锚点将编辑策略映射到其可见的 Markdown 效果；内核 $\ker(ρ)$ 表示潜在模板、路由或实现结构；代数括号衡量非通勤编辑组合。如论文所示，LASKO 在我们的初步基准测试结果中实现了技能优化的数量级加速，主要是因为它取代了在微秒内运行的廉价李括号筛选测试，然后再投资于需要运行大型语言模型的昂贵验证。在从自然语言任务中进行因果提取时，与通过具有 671B 参数的 DeepSeek V3.1 4 位模型运行所有编辑来验证所有编辑的暴力方法相比，LASKO 实现了近 15 美元的加速。

papers.title: IG-GAN: A Generative Adversarial Network for Aerodynamic Data Generation Based on Intrinsic Geometry
papers.abstract: Existing generative models learn data distributions in flat Euclidean space. However, most data in our real world are manifolds embedded in high dimensional Euclidean space. Therefore, we propose an intrinsic-geometry-based generative adversarial network (IG-GAN) for data generation in the field of aerodynamics. The generator of the IG-GAN represents aerodynamic data as a piecewise smooth manifold constructed by Bézier surfaces, and the generator tries to learn the coefficients of each Bézier surface to further combine multiple Bézier surfaces into a smooth manifold automatically. The discriminator in the IG-GAN is a radial-basis-function based discriminator (RBF-D). Experimental results show that IG-GAN achieves lower predicted Mean Squared Errors (MSEs) than those of three baselines. Specifically, on the Burgers' equation dataset, IG-GAN reduces the predicted MSE of velocity u by 97.41% compared with state of the art SSL-Transformer. Additionally, on the ONERA M6 aircraft dataset, IG-GAN reduces the overall MSE of nine aerodynamic coefficients by 82.95% compared with SSL-Transformer.
papers.title_zh: IG-GAN：基于内在几何的空气动力学数据生成的生成对抗网络
papers.abstract_zh: 现有的生成模型学习平坦欧几里得空间中的数据分布。然而，现实世界中的大多数数据都是嵌入高维欧几里得空间中的流形。因此，我们提出了一种基于内在几何的生成对抗网络（IG-GAN），用于空气动力学领域的数据生成。 IG-GAN 的生成器将空气动力学数据表示为由 Bézier 曲面构造的分段平滑流形，并且生成器尝试学习每个 Bézier 曲面的系数，以进一步自动将多个 Bézier 曲面组合成平滑流形。 IG-GAN 中的鉴别器是基于径向基函数的鉴别器（RBF-D）。实验结果表明，IG-GAN 比三个基线实现了更低的预测均方误差 (MSE)。具体来说，在 Burgers 方程数据集上，与最先进的 SSL-Transformer 相比，IG-GAN 将速度 u 的预测 MSE 降低了 97.41%。此外，在 ONERA M6 飞机数据集上，IG-GAN 与 SSL-Transformer 相比，将 9 个空气动力系数的总体 MSE 降低了 82.95%。

papers.title: A Minimalist Retargeting-Guided Reinforcement Learning Recipe for Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Recent work in humanoid whole-body control has found success with a simple recipe: retarget human motion to robot kinematic references, then train policies via reinforcement learning (RL) to track them. But how does this recipe transfer to dexterous manipulation? The answer is not obvious, as manipulation involves complex, contact-rich dynamics and requires delicate regulation of contact modes and forces. We present REGRIND, a minimalist retargeting-guided RL pipeline that learns dexterous manipulation policies from a single human demonstration. REGRIND retargets human hand-object motion to a robot reference that preserves hand-object spatial and contact relationships, trains a residual RL policy in simulation to track object-centric keypoints along that reference, and transfers the resulting policy zero-shot to hardware with careful system identification. The resulting policies produce fluid, human-like behavior on two different multi-fingered hands across contact-rich tool-use tasks, including operating a pair of scissors and turning a screwdriver. Through systematic hardware experiments, we identify and analyze the key factors that govern sim-to-real transfer in dexterous manipulation, offering practical guidance for retargeting-based learning in contact-rich settings. Videos and code are available at https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND.
papers.title_zh: 一种用于灵巧操作的极简重定向引导强化学习方法
papers.abstract_zh: 最近在人形全身控制方面的工作通过一个简单的方法取得了成功：将人体运动重新定位到机器人运动学参考，然后通过强化学习（RL）训练策略来跟踪它们。但这个秘诀如何转化为灵巧的操作呢？答案并不明显，因为操纵涉及复杂的、接触丰富的动力学，并且需要对接触模式和力进行微妙的调节。我们推出了 REGRIND，这是一种极简主义的重定向引导的 RL 管道，可以从单个人类演示中学习灵巧的操纵策略。 REGRIND 将人类手部物体运动重新定位到保留手部物体空间和接触关系的机器人参考，在模拟中训练剩余强化学习策略以跟踪沿该参考的以物体为中心的关键点，并通过仔细的系统识别将生成的策略零样本传输到硬件。由此产生的策略在两只不同的多指手上产生流畅的、类似人类的行为，跨越接触丰富的工具使用任务，包括操作剪刀和转动螺丝刀。通过系统的硬件实验，我们识别并分析了灵巧操作中控制模拟到真实转换的关键因素，为接触丰富的环境中基于重定向的学习提供了实用指导。视频和代码可在 https://yunhaifeng.com/REGRIND 获取。

papers.title: Introducing Human-Centeredness in AI-Assisted Lexicography
papers.abstract: This paper proposes a human-centered artificial intelligence (HCAI) framework for AI-assisted lexicography. While generative AI offers significant opportunities to enhance lexicographic work, it also raises concerns regarding the future role of lexicographers and the preservation of linguistic and cultural diversity. Drawing on HCAI principles and previous applications in other language professions, the paper identifies four interrelated dimensions through which AI integration in lexicography can be understood and critically examined: the augmented lexicographer, the sociotechnical context of AI integration, bias, and the design of AI-powered lexicographic tools. The framework argues that AI should augment rather than replace lexicographers, combining high levels of automation with meaningful human control. It further emphasizes the importance of preserving professional agency, mitigating AI-generated biases, and designing tools around the needs of lexicographers. By doing so, the paper provides a foundation for future research and the beneficial integration of AI into lexicographic workflows.
papers.title_zh: 在人工智能辅助词典编纂中引入以人为本
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种用于人工智能辅助词典编纂的以人为中心的人工智能（HCAI）框架。虽然生成式人工智能为加强词典编纂工作提供了重要机会，但它也引起了人们对词典编纂者未来角色以及语言和文化多样性保护的担忧。借鉴 HCAI 原则和之前在其他语言专业的应用，本文确定了四个相互关联的维度，通过这些维度可以理解和批判性地审查词典编纂中的人工智能集成：增强词典编纂者、人工智能集成的社会技术背景、偏见以及人工智能驱动的词典编纂工具的设计。该框架认为，人工智能应该增强而不是取代词典编纂者，将高水平的自动化与有意义的人类控制结合起来。它进一步强调了保留专业机构、减轻人工智能产生的偏见以及围绕词典编纂者的需求设计工具的重要性。通过这样做，本文为未来的研究以及人工智能与词典编纂工作流程的有益整合奠定了基础。

papers.title: An Explainable Agentic System for Detection of Conversational Scams with Summary-Based Memory
papers.abstract: Following the rapid progress of generative Artificial Intelligence, there is a growing threat posed by conversational scams. These scams often span over multiple weeks or months, gradually build trust and request for money or sensitive information. Existing scam-detection systems mainly focus on isolated messages, which renders them inadequate against this evolving threat. This paper extends single-message phishing detection and presents an explainable agentic system for detecting sophisticated conversational scams. It also introduces ConScamBench-278, an initial public multi-category benchmark for conversational scam detection spanning eight scam types, released to support reproducible evaluation and future expansion. On isolated messages the single-message detector attains 100% phishing recall, while the conversation-level detector identifies all conversational scams in the public LoveFraud02 corpus (83/83) and reaches 97.8% accuracy (95% CI [95.4, 99.0]) on ConScamBench-278. Two user studies (N = 100 and N = 45) further motivate the system: participants report frequently experiencing uncertainty when judging suspicious conversations. In an uncontrolled pre/post comparison, users self-reported trust, self-confidence, and perceived need for AI-based scam detection all increased (p < 0.001, Wilcoxon signed-rank). The system also receives a System Usability Scale score of 74.7 (95% CI [72.5, 76.9]), above the established usability benchmark.
papers.title_zh: 一种可解释的代理系统，用于通过基于摘要的内存检测会话诈骗
papers.abstract_zh: 随着生成人工智能的快速发展，对话诈骗带来的威胁越来越大。这些诈骗通常持续数周或数月，逐渐建立信任并索取金钱或敏感信息。现有的诈骗检测系统主要关注孤立的消息，这使得它们不足以应对这种不断演变的威胁。本文扩展了单消息网络钓鱼检测，并提出了一种可解释的代理系统，用于检测复杂的会话诈骗。它还推出了 ConScamBench-278，这是一个用于对话式诈骗检测的初始公共多类别基准，涵盖八种诈骗类型，其发布是为了支持可重复的评估和未来的扩展。对于孤立的消息，单消息检测器可实现 100% 的网络钓鱼召回率，而会话级检测器可识别公共 LoveFraud02 语料库 (83/83) 中的所有会话诈骗，并在 ConScamBench-278 上达到 97.8% 的准确率（95% CI [95.4, 99.0]）。两项用户研究（N = 100 和 N = 45）进一步激励了该系统：参与者报告在判断可疑对话时经常遇到不确定性。在不受控制的前后比较中，用户自我报告的信任、自信和对基于人工智能的诈骗检测的感知需求均有所增加（p < 0.001，Wilcoxon 符号排名）。该系统的系统可用性量表得分为 74.7（95% CI [72.5, 76.9]），高于既定的可用性基准。

papers.title: LoRA-Based Cascaded Multimodal Fusion for Action Recognition in Medical Training Environments
papers.abstract: This paper presents a cascaded Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)-based multimodal fusion framework for action and activity recognition in healthcare-oriented training environments. The proposed architecture combines parameter-efficient modality-specific adaptation with sequential fusion, enabling modalities to be integrated in stages without retraining previously learned components. Rather than assuming a fixed fusion structure, the framework first integrates more closely related modalities and then incorporates additional heterogeneous modalities, supporting scalable adaptation across datasets with different modality sets.We evaluate the framework on two healthcare-oriented training environment datasets: NurViD and the Nurse Training dataset. Across these datasets, preliminary results suggest that the proposed cascaded fusion strategy improves over individual modality models and provides competitive performance relative to previously reported dataset-specific baselines. Overall, these findings indicate that cascaded LoRA-based fusion is a promising parameter-efficient approach for integrating heterogeneous modalities in medical training action and activity recognition tasks. github: https://github.com/anonymous0-ai/LoRA-Based-Cascaded-Multimodal-Fusion-.git.
papers.title_zh: 基于 LoRA 的级联多模态融合，用于医疗培训环境中的动作识别
papers.abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种基于级联低阶适应 (LoRA) 的多模态融合框架，用于面向医疗保健的培训环境中的动作和活动识别。所提出的架构将参数高效的模态特定自适应与顺序融合相结合，使模态能够分阶段集成，而无需重新训练先前学习的组件。该框架没有假设固定的融合结构，而是首先集成了更密切相关的模态，然后合并了额外的异构模态，支持具有不同模态集的数据集的可扩展适应。我们在两个面向医疗保健的培训环境数据集：NurViD 和护士培训数据集上评估了该框架。在这些数据集中，初步结果表明，所提出的级联融合策略比单个模态模型有所改进，并提供了相对于先前报告的数据集特定基线的竞争性能。总体而言，这些研究结果表明，基于 LoRA 的级联融合是一种很有前途的参数有效方法，用于在医疗训练行动和活动识别任务中集成异构模式。 github：https://github.com/anonymous0-ai/LoRA-Based-Cascaded-Multimodal-Fusion-.git。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for EO Regression Tasks: Building Height, Tree Canopy Height and Above-ground Biomass Estimation
papers.abstract: Earth Observation regression tasks such as building height, canopy height, and above-ground biomass estimation underpin critical applications in urban planning, forest monitoring, and climate policy, where both accuracy and reliability are critical. Yet most deep learning models yield only deterministic predictions, providing no indication of per-pixel reliability. These regression tasks are inherently challenging due to heterogeneous land surfaces, skewed target distributions, sensor noise, and signal saturation at high target values, making uncertainty (UC) estimation essential for reliable inference. We address this gap by modeling aleatoric uncertainty using year-long Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 MSI time series, proposing two complementary approaches: (i) Gaussian UC, which jointly predicts mean and standard deviation under a Gaussian assumption, and (ii) Quantile UC, which estimates the 10th, 50th, and 90th quantiles to capture asymmetric and heteroscedastic error distributions. Both models are evaluated on three representative EO regression tasks at 10 m spatial resolution. Results show that both approaches match or surpass deterministic benchmarks and existing global products, while delivering well-calibrated, interpretable, and operationally useful confidence estimates. Notably, both models outperform the current 10 m state-of-the-art uncertainty-aware model for canopy height estimation. Our implementation will be available at: https://github.com/RituYadav92/EO-Regression-Uncertainty-Estimation
papers.title_zh: EO 回归任务的不确定性量化：建筑高度、树冠高度和地上生物量估算
papers.abstract_zh: 建筑物高度、树冠高度和地上生物量估计等地球观测回归任务支撑着城市规划、森林监测和气候政策中的关键应用，其中准确性和可靠性都至关重要。然而，大多数深度学习模型只能产生确定性预测，无法提供每像素可靠性的指示。由于地表异质、目标分布不均匀、传感器噪声和高目标值下的信号饱和，这些回归任务本质上具有挑战性，这使得不确定性 (UC) 估计对于可靠的推理至关重要。我们通过使用长达一年的 Sentinel-1 SAR 和 Sentinel-2 MSI 时间序列对任意不确定性进行建模来解决这一差距，并提出了两种补充方法：（i）高斯 UC，在高斯假设下联合预测均值和标准差；（ii）分位数 UC，估计第 10、50 和 90 分位数以捕获不对称和异方差误差分布。两种模型均在 10 m 空间分辨率下的三个代表性 EO 回归任务上进行评估。结果表明，这两种方法都匹配或超越了确定性基准和现有的全球产品，同时提供了经过良好校准、可解释且可操作的置信估计。值得注意的是，这两个模型都优于当前用于冠层高度估计的 10 m 最先进的不确定性感知模型。我们的实施将在以下位置提供：https://github.com/RituYadav92/EO-Regression-Uncertainty-Estimation

papers.title: Enhancing Query Efficiency for d-DNNF Representations Through Preprocessing
papers.abstract: In this paper, we investigate preprocessing techniques aimed at improving the efficiency of accessing models of propositional formulas represented in conjunctive normal form (CNF). We focus on three fundamental tasks: uniform sampling, direct model access, and model enumeration. Our analysis reveals that most state-of-the-art preprocessors, when they do not preserve formula equivalence, are generally unsuitable for these tasks. In contrast, we demonstrate that preprocessors which preserve model counts can be effectively leveraged, provided relevant preprocessing information is maintained. To validate our approach, we perform extensive experiments on a diverse suite of benchmarks from multiple domains. The experimental results show that our preprocessing methods are both efficient and robust, yielding significant performance improvements for model access queries when CNF formulas are compiled into d-DNNF representations.
papers.title_zh: 通过预处理提高 d-DNNF 表示的查询效率
papers.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们研究了预处理技术，旨在提高访问以联合范式（CNF）表示的命题公式模型的效率。我们专注于三个基本任务：统一采样、直接模型访问和模型枚举。我们的分析表明，大多数最先进的预处理器在不保留公式等效性时通常不适合这些任务。相比之下，我们证明，只要维护相关的预处理信息，就可以有效地利用保留模型计数的预处理器。为了验证我们的方法，我们对来自多个领域的各种基准套件进行了广泛的实验。实验结果表明，我们的预处理方法既高效又稳健，当 CNF 公式编译成 d-DNNF 表示时，模型访问查询的性能得到显着提高。

papers.title: The Ebb and Flow of Multimodal Focus: Scheduling Visual Relay Windows for Grounded VLM Reasoning
papers.abstract: Vision-language models increasingly succeed on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their visual evidence often becomes unstable once it enters the language stack, weakening evidence-grounded reasoning. To understand this fragility, we examine the internal dynamics of VLMs through a mechanistic lens and uncover a stable three-stage redistribution of multimodal attention focus across depth: an early question-conditioned organization, a critical middle visual-dominant relay, and a late return to answer formation. We operationalize the middle phase as the Visual Relay Window (VRW), and show that its geometry varies with task demand, is causally tied to grounded generation, and distinguishes unsupported answers from stronger reasoning trajectories. Guided by this internal rhythm, we propose TRACE, a task-adaptive inference-time control framework with lightweight trained modules. It reshapes relay allocation during prefill and preserves assembled visual support after handoff during decoding. Across four open-weight VLM backbones and seven benchmarks, TRACE delivers large gains on grounding-sensitive settings, improving them by 4.33 points on average and by up to 6.6 points, while also improving reasoning-heavy tasks. These results show that explicitly controlling multimodal focus across depth offers a unified and effective mechanism for strengthening evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning.
papers.title_zh: 多模态焦点的潮起潮落：为扎根 VLM 推理调度视觉中继窗口
papers.abstract_zh: 视觉语言模型在多模态推理基准上越来越成功，但一旦进入语言堆栈，它们的视觉证据往往会变得不稳定，从而削弱基于证据的推理。为了理解这种脆弱性，我们通过机械透镜检查了 VLM 的内部动态，并揭示了多模式注意力焦点在深度上的稳定的三阶段重新分配：早期的问题条件组织、关键的中间视觉主导中继和晚期返回答案形成。我们将中间阶段操作为视觉中继窗口（VRW），并表明其几何形状随任务需求而变化，与扎根生成有因果关系，并将不受支持的答案与更强的推理轨迹区分开来。在这种内部节奏的指导下，我们提出了 TRACE，一种具有轻量级训练模块的任务自适应推理时间控制框架。它在预填充期间重塑中继分配，并在解码期间切换后保留组装的视觉支持。在四个开放权重 VLM 主干和七个基准测试中，TRACE 在接地敏感设置方面取得了巨大进步，平均提高了 4.33 分，最高提高了 6.6 分，同时还改善了推理繁重的任务。这些结果表明，跨深度明确控制多模态焦点为加强基于证据的多模态推理提供了统一且有效的机制。

papers.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
papers.abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has automated the design of deep learning models but traditionally requires massive computational resources, often measured in thousands of GPU-days. In this paper, we propose a frugal and memetic NAS framework designed to democratize architecture design on consumer-grade hardware. Our approach combines the global macro-search capabilities of an autoregressive Transformer controller, trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL), with the local micro-exploitation of an Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm. To prevent premature convergence during the RL phase, we introduce a dynamic entropy mechanism that forces topological exploration upon detection of performance stagnation. Evaluated on a standard GPU (NVIDIA RTX 3060), our hybrid method effectively resolves the "cold-start" problem inherent in metaheuristics. By algorithmically penalizing network depth, our framework actively mitigates model bloat: on the CIFAR-10 dataset, it discovers an efficient architecture reaching 84.85% accuracy with only $\sim$174,000 parameters (significantly smaller than standard baselines like ResNet-20) in 3 hours of search time. Furthermore, we demonstrate the framework's flexibility by applying it to credit card fraud detection, directly optimizing the F1-Score on highly imbalanced tabular data to reach a F1-Score of 0.71 with a compact network of $\sim$4,600 parameters. These results suggest that our approach can yield tailored, accessible, and highly parameter-efficient deep learning models suitable for edge deployment.
papers.title_zh: 用于节俭神经架构搜索的变压器引导群体智能
papers.abstract_zh: 神经架构搜索 (NAS) 实现了深度学习模型设计的自动化，但传统上需要大量计算资源，通常以数千个 GPU 天来衡量。在本文中，我们提出了一种节俭且模因的 NAS 框架，旨在实现消费级硬件架构设计的民主化。我们的方法结合了通过强化学习 (RL) 训练的自回归 Transformer 控制器的全局宏观搜索功能和人工蜂群 (ABC) 算法的局部微开发。为了防止 RL 阶段过早收敛，我们引入了动态熵机制，在检测到性能停滞时强制进行拓扑探索。在标准 GPU (NVIDIA RTX 3060) 上进行评估，我们的混合方法有效解决了元启发法固有的“冷启动”问题。通过算法惩罚网络深度，我们的框架主动缓解模型膨胀：在 CIFAR-10 数据集上，它发现了一种高效的架构，在 3 小时的搜索时间内仅使用 $\sim$174,000 个参数（明显小于 ResNet-20 等标准基线），准确率达到 84.85%。此外，我们通过将框架应用于信用卡欺诈检测来展示该框架的灵活性，直接优化高度不平衡的表格数据上的 F1-Score，以通过 $\sim$4,600 个参数的紧凑网络达到 0.71 的 F1-Score。这些结果表明，我们的方法可以产生适合边缘部署的定制、可访问且参数高效的深度学习模型。

papers.title: Proxy Exploration and Reusable Guidance: A Modular LLM Post-Training Paradigm via Proxy-Guided Update Signals
papers.abstract: Post-training is essential for refining the domain-specific capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet existing reward optimization and distribution matching methods tightly couple policy exploration with distribution alignment. This coupling forces expensive exploration directly on the policy model and severely hinders the asynchronous generation, reuse, and cross-model transfer of optimization signals. In this paper, we propose Proxy-guided Update Signal Transfer (PUST), a novel post-training framework that fundamentally decouples update-signal exploration from distribution alignment. Instead of utilizing the primary model for costly exploration, PUST employs a lightweight proxy model as an efficient testbed to discover high-reward behaviors. We extract the relative improvement signal between the proxy's initial and optimized states, transferring this directional update to the primary model to guide its policy alignment. This decoupled pipeline, comprising proxy exploration, update-signal extraction, and signal transfer, significantly reduces computational overhead and enables optimization signals to be asynchronously generated, cached, and reused. Crucially, by transferring relative improvements rather than absolute policy distributions, PUST naturally supports weak-to-strong improvement and seamless cross-model transfer. Systematic evaluations on Qwen3-family models across math and code domains demonstrate that update signals extracted from substantially weaker proxies can robustly and adjustably enhance stronger primary models. Ultimately, PUST transforms post-training from a monolithic online optimization process into a highly modular, reusable, and cost-efficient paradigm.
papers.title_zh: 代理探索和可重用指导：通过代理引导更新信号的模块化法学硕士培训后范式
papers.abstract_zh: 后训练对于完善大型语言模型 (LLM) 的特定领域功能至关重要，但现有的奖励优化和分布匹配方法将策略探索与分布对齐紧密结合在一起。这种耦合迫使直接在策略模型上进行昂贵的探索，并严重阻碍了优化信号的异步生成、重用和跨模型传输。在本文中，我们提出了代理引导更新信号传输（PUST），这是一种新颖的训练后框架，从根本上将更新信号探索与分布对齐解耦。 PUST 没有利用主要模型进行成本高昂的探索，而是采用轻量级代理模型作为有效的测试平台来发现高回报行为。我们提取代理的初始状态和优化状态之间的相对改进信号，将此定向更新转移到主要模型以指导其策略调整。这种解耦的管道包括代理探索、更新信号提取和信号传输，显着减少了计算开销，并使优化信号能够异步生成、缓存和重用。至关重要的是，通过转移相对改进而不是绝对策略分布，PUST 自然支持从弱到强的改进和无缝的跨模型转移。对跨数学和代码域的 Qwen3 系列模型的系统评估表明，从较弱的代理中提取的更新信号可以稳健且可调节地增强更强的主要模型。最终，PUST 将训练后从单一的在线优化过程转变为高度模块化、可重用且经济高效的范例。

papers.title: A Multimodal Dataset for Large Language Model Applications in the Energy Domain
papers.abstract: This paper presents the mAIEnergy dataset, an open-access, multimodal corpus developed to support Large Language Model (LLM) applications in the energy sector. The dataset integrates approximately 50,000 textual documents, 20,000 images, 25 million numerical time series records, and 2 million geospatial and relational data entries. It includes policy and regulatory texts, scientific articles and news articles, satellite and contextual imagery, electricity system measurements, weather observations, statistical indicators, and geospatial representations of energy infrastructure and related entities. All data have been harmonized into structured, ready-to-use formats, accompanied by consistent metadata and reproducible data retrieval and preparation workflows. The dataset can serve as a foundational energy knowledge base, allowing energy stakeholders to integrate additional open-source or proprietary data. The mAIEnergy dataset adheres to Findable, Accessible, Interoperable, and Reusable (FAIR) principles, enhancing its applicability for AI-driven energy research, modeling, and decision-making.
papers.title_zh: 用于能源领域大型语言模型应用的多模态数据集
papers.abstract_zh: 本文介绍了 mAIEnergy 数据集，这是一个开放访问的多模式语料库，旨在支持能源领域的大型语言模型 (LLM) 应用。该数据集集成了大约 50,000 个文本文档、20,000 张图像、2500 万条数值时间序列记录以及 200 万个地理空间和关系数据条目。它包括政策和监管文本、科学文章和新闻文章、卫星和背景图像、电力系统测量、天气观测、统计指标以及能源基础设施和相关实体的地理空间表示。所有数据均已统一为结构化、即用型格式，并附有一致的元数据和可重复的数据检索和准备工作流程。该数据集可以作为基础能源知识库，允许能源利益相关者集成其他开源或专有数据。 mAIEnergy 数据集遵循可查找、可访问、可互操作和可重用 (FAIR) 原则，增强了其对人工智能驱动的能源研究、建模和决策的适用性。

papers.title: Comparative Analysis of GAT and BERT for Human-Like Playtesting
papers.abstract: Accurately modeling and understanding player experience is crucial for designing engaging puzzle games. To achieve this, a common approach involves collecting diverse user data to train predictive playtesting models that mimic player behavior. However, existing data-driven methods often lack the ability to capture the full range of player strategies and require extensive feature engineering and network architecture modeling. This limitation becomes particularly evident when new game mechanics or features are introduced, which necessitate continual adjustments to the models. To addrss these challenges, we propose a more generalized representation that reduces - or even eliminates - the need for ongoing feature-engineering maintenance. Specifically, we investigate two general-purpose network architectures: (a) a transformer-based model (BERT) and (b) a graph attention model (GAT), both of which are designed to effectively capture the relational structure of Candy Crush Saga (CCS) game boards. Our experiments compare these approaches to Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) baselines, revealing better performance on challenging board configurations and underscoring the benefits of our generalizable representation.
papers.title_zh: GAT 和 BERT 类人游戏测试的比较分析
papers.abstract_zh: 准确建模和理解玩家体验对于设计引人入胜的益智游戏至关重要。为了实现这一目标，一种常见的方法是收集不同的用户数据来训练模仿玩家行为的预测游戏测试模型。然而，现有的数据驱动方法通常缺乏捕获全方位玩家策略的能力，并且需要大量的特征工程和网络架构建模。当引入新的游戏机制或功能时，这种限制变得尤其明显，需要不断调整模型。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种更通用的表示方法，可以减少甚至消除持续的特征工程维护的需要。具体来说，我们研究了两种通用网络架构：(a) 基于变压器的模型 (BERT) 和 (b) 图注意力模型 (GAT)，这两种模型都旨在有效捕获 Candy Crush Saga (CCS) 游戏板的关系结构。我们的实验将这些方法与卷积神经网络 (CNN) 基线进行比较，揭示了在具有挑战性的电路板配置上的更好性能，并强调了我们可推广表示的好处。
